entries.title: Day 1 — Back
entries.text: I got here. There's a note in my pocket I don't remember writing: "Come back. School is boring without you."

entries.title: Day 2 — The voice
entries.text: The loudspeaker said my name before I had introduced myself to anyone. "This time, try—". No one else heard.

entries.title: Day 3 — K.M.
entries.text: An empty desk with the initials K.M. I wrote the same letters in the margin of my notebook without noticing.

entries.title: Day 4 — The notebook
entries.text: A black notebook in my locker, in my handwriting, with dates that haven't happened yet. The pages after day 12 were torn out.

entries.title: Day 5 — The festival
entries.text: Festival on day 12, at night, with lanterns. The last date in the notebook. Someone called a student named Kaito Mori and then said he doesn't exist.

entries.title: Day 6 — The hands
entries.text: Raw knuckles. On the wall: DON'T GO UP. The handwriting is mine. There's plaster under my nails.

entries.title: Day 7 — The photo
entries.text: The desk is gone. The clock stopped at 21:47. In the class photo there's a face layered over and over. One for each loop.

entries.title: Day 8 — The stairs
entries.text: I went up without remembering deciding to. Beyond the door, another school. Tally marks. Maya knows everything.

entries.title: Alice's notebook
entries.text: Dates written backward. The last one is the festival. The first one is tomorrow. She let me read it, and I couldn't stop.

entries.title: The truth
entries.text: Kaito Mori. My best friend. I was holding his hand when the rain made him slip. It was an accident. I just couldn't hold on.

entries.title: Forgetting
entries.text: I asked to forget. It works for a day. But my hand still closes by itself, as if holding someone.

entries.title: Letting go
entries.text: I said under my breath that I'd let him go. It hurt more than any wound. For a second the clock moved.

entries.title: The name on the lantern
entries.text: I wrote his name on a white lantern, in the firmest handwriting I had. I almost managed to breathe.

entries.title: Maya
entries.text: She knows more than she says. I think she's been carrying the weight for all of us, alone, for a long time.

entries.title: Yuna
entries.text: Her smile is something she does for everyone. When she really laughs, it's a different laugh: quieter.

entries.title: Alice
entries.text: She writes everything down so she won't forget, and I think she's forgotten how much she remembers. I trust her more than my own notebook.

entries.title: Hikari
entries.text: She runs so she won't have to stand still. I think when she stops, she'll have to feel everything at once.

entries.title: Fear
entries.text: I'm afraid the fear is what keeps me here.

entries.title: Again
entries.text: I've written these words before. The handwriting is the same. The ink is older.
